title: aug-2015-sexual-offences-definitive-guideline-web.pdf — section 131
text:
TRAFFICKING FOR SEXUAL EXPLOITATION
Trafficking people for sexual
exploitation
Sexual Offences Act 2003 (sections 59A)
(This guideline also applies to offences, committed before 6 April 2013, of trafficking
into/within/out of the UK for sexual exploitation contrary to sections 57 to 59 of the
Sexual Offences Act 2003)
Triable either way
Maximum: 14 years’ custody
Offence range: Community order – 12 years’ custody
For convictions on or after 3 December 2012 (irrespective of the date of commission of the
offence), this is a specified offence for the purposes of section 226A (extended sentence for
certain violent or sexual offences) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003.
The term “prostitution” is used in this guideline in accordance with the statutory language contained in the Sexual
Offences Act 2003.
